intro.title: Get the verified badge
intro.callout: Verified businesses get more enquiries. We check your GSTIN with the GST network. It's free.
intro.instantStep2: Check the business we find and confirm it's yours.
intro.instantStep3: Enter the code sent to the phone or email registered with GST.
intro.reviewStep1: Enter your GSTIN and upload your GST certificate with an ID or an authorisation letter.
intro.reviewStep2: Our team checks it, usually within one working day.

found.subtitle: Check the details from the GST network.

declare.subtitle: Only someone who runs this business can verify it.
declare.text: I am the proprietor, partner, director or authorised signatory of this business.

documents.title: Documents
documents.rule: Add 2 to 5 files: your GST registration certificate, and an ID of a person named on it or an authorisation letter. JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB each.
documents.fileType: Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF file
documents.tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB
documents.needPerson: Add an ID of a person named on the certificate, or an authorisation letter
documents.max_other: You can add up to {{count}} files
documents.cameraDenied: Allow the camera to take a photo, or pick a file instead
documents.unavailable: Document upload isn't available yet. Please try again later.

underReview.title: Under review
underReview.body: Usually within one working day. You can keep using the app.

needsMore.title: We need a little more
needsMore.body: Our team needs more documents to verify your GST.
needsMore.sent: Files sent. Your review is back in the queue.

verified.title: GST verified
verified.body: Your business shows the verified badge.
verified.since: Verified on {{date}}. Your business shows the verified badge.

revoked.title: GST verification removed
revoked.body: Our team removed your GST verification.
